title: Why the Tall Ones Carry Stones
author: a nursemaid's tale
pages: Why do the Tall Ones carry stones, Nurse? Because they are building a house, little one. They have been building it a very long time, and they have forgotten where they put the first stone.
Why do they hurt you if you look at them? Because once they were looked at by someone they loved, and they cannot bear that you are not him. So keep your eyes on your shoes and let them pass.
Where do they go when they vanish? Home, or the nearest thing to it. There is a place past the edge of the stars where they came from. They do not like it there either.
Will they take my blocks? Only the ones they need, to put somewhere else for their house. Leave them a stone by the gate if you like. It is good manners and costs nothing.
